Facts used:
- Stonecairn’s 2025 budget was 2,884.6 million tenge (NR-06).
- Stonecairn’s 2025 population was 14,926 residents (NR-06).
- Coldharbour’s 2025 budget was 2,366.9 million tenge (NR-12).
- Coldharbour’s 2025 population was 11,407 residents (NR-12).
- One million tenge equals 1,000,000 tenge (implicit in “million tenge” in NR-06 and NR-12).

Calculations:
- Stonecairn budget per resident = 2,884.6 × 1,000,000 ÷ 14,926 = 193,281.978 tenge per resident.
- Coldharbour budget per resident = 2,366.9 × 1,000,000 ÷ 11,407 = 207,496.274 tenge per resident.
- Difference = 207,496.274 − 193,281.978 = 14,214.296 tenge per resident.
- Coldharbour had the larger budget per resident.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 14214.296
